; midad: load the ayah bar (QML on the tablet) into the open document's scene view.
; The bar itself lives in /home/root/midad/qml/AyahBar.qml.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
    TRAVERSE ?#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: ayahBarLoader
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 1000
                source: "file:///home/root/midad/qml/AyahBar.qml"
                onLoaded: item.sceneView = root
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
